mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO auth_admin_idempotency (id, actor_user_id, operation, idempotency_key, payload_hash, resource_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{actorUserId}, #{operation}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{payloadHash}, #{resourceId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
